matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR converges roughly ten times faster than the original DETR while achieving better detection performance, particularly on small objects.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR achieves better detection performance than DETR with 10 times fewer training epochs.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Multi-scale deformable attention naturally handles small objects efficiently without resorting to a separately constructed multi-scale feature pyramid head.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Adding FPN on top of multi-scale deformable attention does not improve detection performance.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR replaces dense attention with deformable attention modules that attend to a small set of sampling points per query, reducing computational complexity.
